arguments.sql:
SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.CPK < 250
        AND CAST(NULLIF(l.RNP, 'negative') AS REAL) > 4
  )
ORDER BY p.ID
LIMIT -1
